comment: Icon manifest. SVGs in ./svg are the exact bytes exported from Figma —
never redrawn by hand. scripts/build-icons.mjs turns them into React
components in ./generated.tsx with every fill/stroke rewritten to
currentColor, so an icon inherits colour from its container.
`box` is the icon's OUTER frame in Figma, and `size` on the component
scales that frame. This matters: Figma sizes refer to the outer box, not
the artwork. The chevron's box is 24 and its glyph is only 9.99x5.49
inside it, so `chevron (10px)` in BU-6 means a 10px BOX holding a ~4.2px
glyph. Rendering the leaf at 10px makes it roughly four times too large.
`x`/`y` place each part's leaf inside that box. They are derived from the
percentage insets Figma reports, including the negative inner inset it
uses for stroke bleed — not eyeballed.
Leaves keep their own proportions; several icons are deliberately not
square (logo-beta's box is 55x47). Do not normalise them.

parts.comment: Figma applies -rotate-180 -scale-x-100 on the wrapper, which composes to a vertical flip. The exported vector does NOT include it, so without this the beta renders upside down.
